rename_atomic_data_keys: rename keys on an AtomicData object using a key mapping dictionary
rename_data_object_keys_single: rename a single key on an AtomicData object from energy to target_energy
rename_data_object_keys_multi: rename a key on an AtomicData object to multiple new keys like common_energy and oc20_energy
rename_data_object_keys_preserve: rename a key on an AtomicData object while preserving the original key in the mapping
rename_data_object_keys_missing: rename keys on an AtomicData object safely skipping keys not present in the data
